$comment: Optional per-repository overrides, keyed by repository name (renames are followed automatically). Every field is optional. The sync never writes to this file.

$fields.featured: true → shown first, in the large card layout
$fields.hidden: true → never shown on the site (the repo stays public on GitHub)
$fields.curated: true → the repo already has a hand-written card on projects.html, so it is not duplicated in the auto-synced grid
$fields.category: label shown above the title (defaults to primary language)
$fields.summary: your own one-paragraph summary (defaults to the GitHub description / README)
$fields.image: path or https URL of a cover image (defaults to the first README image, then GitHub's social preview)
$fields.demo: live demo URL (defaults to the repo homepage, GitHub Pages, or a demo link found in the README)
$fields.order: number; lower sorts earlier among featured projects

Task_Manager.summary: A clean, responsive task management interface built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Focused on frictionless UX — add, complete, and clear tasks without page reloads.

PersonaLearn.summary: ML-powered system that personalises content delivery based on learner behaviour patterns. Adapts difficulty and format dynamically — built with Python and Streamlit.

Movie_Recommender_System.summary: Content-based recommendation engine using cosine similarity on TF-IDF vectors. Built with Python, scikit-learn, and Streamlit — surfaces relevant titles from a dataset of 5,000+ films.

Mybuddy.summary: An early personal LLM assistant built before agentic frameworks made this pattern mainstream. Conversational AI with a custom system prompt and memory-aware context — my first deep exploration into LLM application design.
